entries.transformation: Copy immutable publication provenance into the sealed leapview.dev/odcs-extension/v1 value.
entries.limitations: The extension carries provenance only and cannot preserve executable or access semantics.
entries.compatibilityImpact: Changing its closed shape requires a new extension namespace.

entries.transformation: Join the existing instance ID and authored resource ID with a slash.
entries.limitations: ODCS does not prescribe a global identifier URI format.
entries.compatibilityImpact: Either identity component changes the exported ODCS identity.
Changing the literal breaks the ODCS profile.

entries.limitations: Display names and descriptive prose are excluded by leapview.contract/v1.
entries.compatibilityImpact: The value follows the published projection version.

entries.transformation: Emit active for an immutable published contract version.
entries.limitations: ODCS status combines publication and activation lifecycle concepts; LeapView publication evidence does not prove serving activation.

entries.transformation: Copy the authored semantic version preserved in canonical bytes.
entries.limitations: Build metadata remains subject to the FAI-622 publication baseline policy.
entries.compatibilityImpact: Governed by the existing LeapView SemVer classifier.

entries.transformation: Map the closed LeapView logical datatype vocabulary to ODCS 3.1 logicalType.
entries.limitations: Decimal loses its exact-vs-approximate distinction; Opaque is rejected.
entries.compatibilityImpact: Datatype changes remain breaking under the LeapView classifier.

entries.transformation: Emit identifier-keyed fields as a name-sorted ODCS property array.
entries.limitations: ODCS array order is normalized lexically and is not semantic.
entries.compatibilityImpact: Addition/removal/type compatibility remains governed by FAI-622.

entries.transformation: Invert nullable when specified; omit required when nullability is unspecified.
entries.limitations: ODCS required means the value may not be null.
entries.compatibilityImpact: Nullability widening remains breaking under the LeapView classifier.

entries.transformation: Map the selected primary grain positionally and lossless single-field unique entities.
entries.limitations: Foreign, natural, and composite unique entity semantics require explicit loss entries.
entries.compatibilityImpact: Dropped/degraded entity semantics prohibit round-trip conformance.

entries.transformation: Map closed non-null, unique, accepted-values, relationship, and row-count checks to ODCS library metrics or relationships.
entries.limitations: Relationship shorthand must resolve within the exported object; external targets require unavailable contract authority and reject export. ODCS generic arguments do not fully standardize accepted-value or composite-unique execution; those mappings are reported degraded.
entries.compatibilityImpact: Unsupported or internally inconsistent checks reject export.

entries.transformation: Emit one object named after the published Source or Model with logicalType object.
entries.limitations: Physical names and target bindings are intentionally absent.
entries.compatibilityImpact: The object follows the published resource identity and version.
